# Why did Amazon reject my inventory file?

> Free Amazon Seller Central inventory file checker: finds comma or UTF-16 files, UPCs that lost a leading zero, bad UPC and EAN check digits, scientific-notation SKUs, bad prices and quantities, wrong add-delete codes and missing condition notes, with line numbers, and applies safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
